messages:
maya: Starting staged rollout v3.4.2 — kicking off 5% canary in us-west now. holding for QA and release-notes link. LMK if objections. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary v3.4.2 -> 5% traffic (us-west). Instances: canary-1..canary-6. Command: `deploy canary --version v3.4.2 --region us-west --percent 5`

sam: QA quick smoke running.

lin: Watching infra metrics (latency, errors, kv-cache). Will report within 5m.

jessie: Release notes draft missing the breaking changes section — can we pause if anything shows up? link: https://redwood/release/v3.4.2/notes

paul: infra note: us-west pod group has low headroom, but fine at 5%.

deploy-bot: healthcheck 1/6 ok, 2/6 ok, 3/6 degraded (high p95). Details: `500 errors` on embed service proxied to eu-backend for some requests.

lin: seeing p95 embed latency 2.4s for requests routed to eu-backend via us-west -> cause may be cross-region routing for some tenants.

maya: hmm - is this impacting only canary traffic?

lin: yes, only on canary hosts. Rate ~0.5% of total but error class is mostly 502/504.

sam: recommend pausing and rolling back canary from eu-affected customers, or pin earlier version in eu region. Thoughts?

jessie: I'm for pausing — product flagged a regression in embed formatting too (small sample from experiments).

maya: ok let's do a partial rollback: abort canary globally, then re-deploy v3.4.1 to eu-west and keep us-west canary off for now. Need pin and patch release notes update.

deploy-bot: aborting canary... running rollback: `deploy rollback --version v3.4.1 --region eu-west --target canary`

deploy-bot: rollback complete: eu-west canary reverted to v3.4.1. Global canary traffic drained.

lin: confirming metrics: canary instances removed from lb in eu-west, p95 back to baseline.

paul: pin applied: eu-west routing -> v3.4.1 (sticky) for affected customers. Command run: `route pin --region eu-west --version v3.4.1 --sticky true`

sam: we'll reopen a small investigation doc. tagging infra to follow up: @paul @lin

jessie: I'll update release notes with regression + rollback note. assigning to @jessie.

maya: change window note: delaying full rollout until patch v3.4.3 and new QA signoff. change-window: today 22:00 UTC? ok?

sam: +1 for 22:00 UTC. notify sales/support.

ops-bot: Pager muted for rollout channel. Notifying #support and releasing incident note: https://redwood/incidents/1788888888

maya: thanks all. re-run canary when we have patch and release notes. :thumbsup:
